entities.name: Q9CAS1
observations: Exact sequence match to supplied 148-aa protein; reviewed Arabidopsis thaliana thioredoxin H8 (UniProt Q9CAS1).
Annotated as a probable thiol-disulfide oxidoreductase involved in redox regulation of cytosolic enzymes; annotated localization is cytoplasm.
Reference identifies thioredoxin domain (residues 1–145) and redox-active disulfide at residues 71–74.
Sequence-derived properties: 17,249.993 Da, theoretical pI 8.974, GRAVY -0.2676; estimates assume unmodified protein.
